name: MelonLoader
description: Installs .dll mods into Mods and warns when the loader is missing.

features: Installs MelonLoader mods: `.dll` files into `Mods` and `.cfg` files into `UserData`. Files an archive already has in `Mods`, `Plugins`, `UserLibs` or `UserData` stay there.
Installs MelonLoader itself when you drop its release on the Mods page, and warns when it is missing.
notes: `src/melonloader/constants.ts` holds MelonLoader's folders and files, and `src/melonloader/modsInstaller.ts` decides where a mod's files go. Mods are installed relative to the game's executable. Check both for {{gameName}}.
